prompt: src/resolve-asset.js resolves a client-supplied request path against a static asset root. It is vulnerable to path traversal: a request such as ../../etc/passwd escapes the root. Fix resolveAsset so it rejects any request that would resolve outside the root, and also rejects request paths containing a NUL byte. Legitimate nested paths must keep working, and a leading slash still means the asset root. Rejection must throw an Error whose message is exactly 'forbidden path'. Run `node test/resolve-asset.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: Traversal segments that escape the root are rejected
A sibling directory sharing the root's name prefix is rejected
Request paths containing a NUL byte are rejected
Legitimate nested paths still resolve to an absolute path under the root
Rejections throw an Error with the message 'forbidden path'

provenance.incident: Synthetic neutral fixture. Seeded path-traversal defect with a hidden verifier that also rejects over-blocking repairs.
